entries.claim: The Generic Host Adapter Boundary supplies raw_host_input, capability evidence, bounded host services, authorization transport, and receipts without constructing TurnRequest.
limitations: Does not prove a Codex surface supplies any capability.

entries.claim: Local command execution is constrained by sandbox boundaries and approvals are a separate control.
limitations: Specific boundaries depend on surface and configuration.

entries.claim: Filesystem, command, and network permissions vary by mode; sandbox and approval reviewer are distinct.
limitations: Organization and local configuration can disable modes.

entries.claim: Codex clients can expose web search in configuration-dependent indexed, live, or disabled modes.
limitations: Search mode does not imply raw network access.

entries.claim: Supported Codex clients can connect to configured MCP servers and exposed tools/context vary by configuration and server.
limitations: Configured server presence and per-tool availability are not guaranteed.

entries.claim: Codex desktop documents a project/worktree-scoped terminal for commands, checks, and Git operations.
limitations: Actual commands remain constrained by sandbox, approvals, and installed tools.

entries.claim: Codex desktop supports distinct local, worktree, and cloud execution environments.
limitations: The selected environment does not establish all permissions or tools.

entries.claim: Desktop worktree chats isolate file checkouts while sharing Git metadata and can support scheduled-task worktrees.
limitations: Worktree identity is not security-grade authorization state.

entries.claim: Supported Codex client surfaces document image input workflows.
limitations: Current image-input operation was not invoked.

entries.claim: Supported Codex desktop surfaces can use a separately installed and permissioned Computer Use plugin for GUI actions.
limitations: Current installation, app access, and operation receipt were not probed.

source.description: Host metadata supplied to the current turn and sanitized OS/workspace probe.

entries.claim: Observed Windows x64 local checkout with workspace-write sandbox, auto-review approval mode, restricted network policy, and writable root D:/Repos/Blu_Core.
limitations: Client version could not be safely confirmed.
Does not generalize to another Codex surface/session.

source.description: Bounded PowerShell probe completed with exit code 0 and returned OS, Python 3.12.10, Git 2.52.0.windows.1, workspace, repository, branch, HEAD, tracked-file and remote counts.

entries.claim: Shell execution and stdout/exit-code receipts are available in the current workspace scope.
limitations: Does not prove arbitrary commands, environment-secret access, network, or execution beyond sandbox.

source.description: Git status/read probes, authorized origin fetch and fast-forward pull, exact-base check, and branch creation returned successful receipts.

entries.claim: Repository detection, Git reads, named-remote fetch/pull under approval, and local branch creation were available for these operations.
entries.scope: Blu_Core repository and named operations only
limitations: Does not prove commit, push, PR, or unrestricted remote access.

source.description: The current binding searched and opened current first-party OpenAI documentation through its web-search provider.

entries.claim: Web search and page retrieval were available for the observed calls.
limitations: Search tool capability is distinct from raw network access and may change by configuration.

source.description: Current time provider returned 2026-08-08T23:05:40-05:00 for UTC-05:00.

entries.claim: A verified current-time result was available for that invocation and offset.
limitations: Does not establish persistent availability or timezone identity beyond the supplied offset.

source.description: Current host tool metadata exposed web, shell, image, document/spreadsheet/presentation, MCP/plugin, Gmail, Sites, thread-management, and automation interfaces. No capability operation was invoked solely to strengthen status.

entries.claim: Dynamic external tool metadata and an automation management interface are exposed in the current binding.
entries.scope: tool names/descriptions exposed to this turn
limitations: Metadata exposure does not prove credentials, provider connection, permission, operation success, or receipts.

source.description: Get-Command located the packaged executable, but executing codex --version returned access denied inside the bounded environment.

entries.claim: Client version is unknown; no version string is inferred from the package path.
limitations: Failure to execute the probe does not prove the Codex client is unavailable.

source.description: The user-supplied BC-020 host attachment was exposed as a host-managed local attachment path and read successfully for this assignment.

entries.claim: Attached-file retrieval was available for this attachment and turn.
limitations: Does not prove all attachment types, stable paths, or Chat attachment semantics.

source.description: Workspace patch operations created and updated BC-020 specification files under D:/Repos/Blu_Core without leaving the approved writable root.

entries.claim: Workspace-scoped filesystem write and create operations were available for these files.
entries.scope: approved BC-020 collision domain inside D:/Repos/Blu_Core
limitations: Does not prove delete, rename, unrestricted filesystem, or persistence beyond repository state.

source.description: The current host delivered the user's text request and structured tool results and accepted assistant natural-language progress output.

entries.claim: Text input, structured host result input, and natural-language host delivery are available for this turn.
limitations: Host acceptance/display does not prove the human read the output.

source.description: Inspection of the current host metadata and exposed tool contracts found no supported provider record for host-session integrity, request/result binding, prior-consumption state, replay rejection, or monotonic/rollback-resistant attempt_count.

entries.claim: Security-grade protected cross-turn continuation evidence is unavailable through the adapter-visible interface in this observed binding.
limitations: Does not prove all Codex surfaces or future versions lack such a provider.
